title: Distractor Plausibility Audit

classification_rubric.strong: Targets specific misconception documented in CMA exam-trap literature. Requires genuine content knowledge to eliminate. Would fool a candidate who holds that misconception.
classification_rubric.acceptable: Plausible but surface-level. Test-taking strategies could help eliminate this distractor. Covers a real but shallow misconception.
classification_rubric.weak: Eliminable by test-taking tricks alone (length cueing, grammatical mismatch, absolute language). Does not require content knowledge to dismiss.
classification_rubric.rewrite_needed: Obviously wrong (absurd number, nonsensical concept, contradicts scenario facts). Or nonsensical text. Or 100% duplicate of another distractor in same item.

strong.profile: Pack B and Pack E dominate. Independent authoring produces genuinely choice-specific, misconception-targeting distractors.

acceptable.profile: Pack A/C/D certified sections. Distractors are plausible but some lack authoritative-standard anchoring in EW text.

weak.profile: DL-003 absolute-language distractors (228 hits). DL-005 high-similarity distractors. Early-rotation template distractors in unprocessed sections.

rewrite_needed.profile: DL-005 100%-identical distractors. DL-013 boilerplate EW text (184). Absolutist giveaways ('in all cases', 'guarantees in every case'). 7-item 'it guarantees goal congruence in all cases' clone group.

A_External_Financial_Reporting.notes: Good distractor discrimination in calculation-heavy items. Numerical distractors map well to common errors.

B_Planning_Budgeting_Forecasting.notes: Conceptual items have more weak distractors. Budgeting framework choices sometimes too similar.

C_Performance_Management.notes: Variance analysis distractors are calculation-based and strong. Responsibility-center conceptual distractors weaker.

D_Cost_Management.notes: Best domain for distractor quality. Overhead allocation and joint-cost distractors consistently strong.

E_Internal_Controls.notes: COSO/ITGC distractors benefit from distinct framework components as natural alternatives.

F_Technology_Analytics.notes: Emerging topic — distractors written with current technology trends as plausible alternatives. Highest strong%.

critical_finding: The 'it guarantees goal congruence in all cases' absolutist distractor appears in 7 consecutive items (P1-CC-021 through P1-CC-027) — a DL-012 clone-rotation artifact. All 7 items in Pack C Section C are Unprocessed, making this the single largest concentrated rewrite target.
